SELECT t.std_rest_cd, t.base_month, t.rank_no, t.display_name, t.store_name, m.price FROM rest_area_top_item t JOIN (SELECT std_rest_cd, MAX(base_month) AS base_month FROM rest_area_top_item WHERE std_rest_cd IN GROUP BY std_rest_cd) latest ON latest.std_rest_cd = t.std_rest_cd AND latest.base_month = t.base_month LEFT JOIN rest_area_menu m ON m.id = t.menu_id ORDER BY t.std_rest_cd, t.rank_no
SELECT brd_name, open_time, close_time FROM rest_area_brand WHERE std_rest_cd = #{code} ORDER BY id
SELECT std_rest_cd, source, ps_code, name, detail, open_time, close_time FROM facility WHERE std_rest_cd IN ORDER BY std_rest_cd, CASE source WHEN 'REST_AREA' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ps_code, id
